custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test with 3 on hand.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425715 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425715-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, pick vendor A under Vendor, type 3 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor; type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425715 VENDOR A in Name *, then click Save & Close. (Create the vendor first.)
  • Create a vendor return for this test, return A, for part A and vendor A, saved and not completed.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Returns in the left menu, then Create Return; pick vendor A under Vendor, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425715-A in Part Number and pick it, type 1 in Quantity, then click Save Return.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
